subject: Intro: GreenPath Logistics — co-sell intro & ops plan
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Simon Clarke <simon.clarke@amazon.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Intro: GreenPath Logistics — co-sell intro & ops plan

Hi Simon / team,

Following the marketplace listing refresh we discussed at re:Invent, AWS mentioned GreenPath Logistics as an initial target for a joint go-to-market intro. GreenPath is evaluating multi-cloud inference for routing optimization and is particularly interested in a hosted + dedicated deployment mix.

Can you make the official intro to their procurement / cloud lead (Sara Jensen) and copy our reps? I drafted a one-paragraph intro and a proposed ops plan below to save time. If AWS prefers to lead with a custom intro, happy to adapt.

Proposed quick ask to Sara:
- 30–45m intro to share use case, timelines, and procurement expectations
- We’ll demo the marketplace listing + performance summary and surface any security/compliance artifacts Amazon needs for co-sell registration

Suggested workshop agenda (attached):
1) 10m intros & objectives
2) 15m customer pain + current infra
3) 20m Redwood demo (marketplace listing + perf/SLAs)
4) 15m next steps / mutual action plan

Attachments: agenda_co-sell_workshop.pdf, aws_intro_template.txt

Marissa — I’ll need you to own the mutual action plan (MAM) draft and the first draft of the SOW template. Karthik — can you confirm which AM/SE will join for the technical deep-dive?

Thanks,
Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Head of Partnerships (Marketplace)
Redwood Inference
From: Simon Clarke <simon.clarke@amazon.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Intro: GreenPath Logistics — co-sell intro & ops plan

Thanks Rafael — happy to coordinate. I can introduce Sara and her cloud team today. Quick notes from the AWS side:
- I’ll include our AM (Laura Ng) and the regional co-sell coordinator so we can register the deal in the AWS ISV Accelerate pipeline.
- Please include a short SOC2 / security pointer in the intro so procurement has context.

I’ll send the intro and propose two times for next week (Tue/Wed morning PT). Attached is an intro template I use — feel free to edit.

Regards,
Simon Clarke
Senior Partner Manager, AWS
Attachments: aws_intro_template.txt

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Simon Clarke <simon.clarke@amazon.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T12:07:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Intro: GreenPath Logistics — co-sell intro & ops plan

Great — I’ll take the MAM. Draft plan (high level):
- Week 1: Intro + discovery (30–45m) — owners: AWS (intro), Redwood (use-case + demo)
- Week 2: Technical deep-dive + PoC scoping (60m) — owners: Redwood SE, GreenPath infra
- Week 3–5: PoC execution (2–4 wks) — owners: GreenPath & Redwood devs
- Week 6: Executive review + procurement check-in (deliverable: draft SOW & TCO)

Open items for Rafael / Simon:
- Who from AWS will be the SE for deep-dive? (Karthik — any suggestions?)
- Sara — will GreenPath need an NDA before demo/customer data is shared?

I attached the MAM template (mutual_action_plan_v1.docx). I’ll create a shared Drive folder and drop the MAM + SOW draft after the intro. Rafael — will you set up a calendar invite once Simon proposes times?

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachments: mutual_action_plan_v1.docx

To: Simon Clarke <simon.clarke@amazon.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T15:43:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Intro: GreenPath Logistics — co-sell intro & ops plan

Hi Simon / Rafael / Marissa,

Thanks for the quick touch. Happy to meet — Tuesday (2026-12-08) 10:00 PT or Wednesday (2026-12-09) 09:30 PT works for our team. We’re primarily interested in three things:
1) A short architecture overview of how Redwood would sit alongside our existing GCP workloads (we’re multi-cloud)
2) Expected latency and cost delta for hybrid hosted + dedicated setup
3) Security artifacts: SOC2 report, data residency controls, and audit logging details

We generally prefer to see a vendor SOC2 before sharing any production data; if you can provide the redacted report or a pointer to where AWS co-sell can access the compliance pack, that will speed procurement.

I’ve copied our cloud lead, Daniel Park (daniel.park@greenpath.com), in case he needs to add availability. Rafael / Marissa — could you share the Drive link with the MAM + the draft SOW once available?

Best,
Sara Jensen
Head of Cloud & Infrastructure
GreenPath Logistics
